lead.en: Follow an agent through context gathering, tool calls, and verification.
lead.zh: 沿着圆环查看智能体收集上下文、调用工具和验证结果的过程。

rule.en: Use Play/Pause, Next step or Restart to control the sample run. Tab to the controls and use the arrow keys to choose a playback speed. The host supplies the timeline; the component does not call an agent or tools.
rule.zh: 使用播放／暂停、下一步和重新开始控制示例。用 Tab 聚焦控件，方向键切换播放速度。流程数据由宿主提供，组件不会调用真实智能体或工具。

api.en: Use set_playing, step, restart and set_speed. Autoplay is off by default; autoplay(true) starts the first visible run. Set visibility in an embedded host to pause when the preview leaves the viewport. Events report station changes and completion.
api.zh: 可调用 set_playing、step、restart 和 set_speed。默认关闭自动播放；autoplay(true) 在首次可见时启动。嵌入预览可用 visibility 报告可见性。事件报告站点变化和结束状态。

motion.en: The active point travels clockwise and pauses in place. Tools and checks resolve in fixed slots. Off-screen playback pauses. Reduced motion removes the moving trail and reveals each step without travel.
motion.zh: 活动点沿顺时针前进，暂停时保持原位。工具与检查在固定位置显示结果，离屏时暂停。减少动效时去掉移动尾迹，单步直接显示结果。
